task.title: Move validation engine into gateway layer
task.summary: Make gateway the pass/fail/block decision layer by moving/renaming validation report, preflight, tool, and types under src/gateway/** and folding current gateway transaction/catalog plumbing into that layer.

goal.outcome: Gateway is the source owner for lifecycle pass/fail/block decisions; validation is no longer a separate generic implementation layer.
acceptance: src/validation/** live source is removed or no longer owns implementation behavior.
Gateway docs/skills/tests use gateway naming for pass/fail/block reports and preflight.
Existing validation behavior is preserved under gateway names and all gateway/preflight/build tests pass.
non_goals: Do not standardize every internal agent tool name in this task beyond gateway-specific names.
Do not change policy/check semantics beyond imports needed for gateway migration.
Do not push or publish remotely.
verification: search proves live src/validation implementation ownership is removed.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
